I’ll check both streaming adapters, apply the Python style guidance, and add focused tests for tool-call indices across chunks.
The causes match your report: Gemini hardcodes index 0, and LiteLLM uses the call’s position within each chunk. I’ll keep Gemini’s counter local to each stream and choice, and make LiteLLM preserve explicit indices, including 0.
Implemented both fixes:

- Gemini assigns consecutive tool-call indices across chunks, resetting for each new stream.
- LiteLLM preserves supplied indices and falls back to chunk position only when absent or `None`.

Added regression tests for parallel calls, interleaved chunks, fallback indices, and stream resets.

All 128 tests in the two provider files passed; pytest then hit a sandbox permission error in its process-reporting teardown. No dependencies were installed.

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("call_counts", [[2], [1, 1], [2, 0, 1]])
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_gemini_chat_stream_tool_call_indices(call_counts):
+    responses = []
+    for count in call_counts:
+        parts = [{"text": "Checking the weather."}] + [
+            {"functionCall": {"name": "get_weather", "args": {"location": "Singapore"}}}
+            for _ in range(count)
+        ]
+        data = {"candidates": [{"content": {"parts": parts}}]}
+        responses.append(f"data: {json.dumps(data)}\n\n".encode())
+    responses.append(b"data: [DONE]\n\n")
+    provider = GeminiProvider(EndpointConfig(**chat_config()))
+    payload = chat.RequestPayload(**chat_function_calling_payload(stream=True))
+
+    for _ in range(2):
+        mock_client = mock_http_client(MockAsyncStreamingResponse(responses))
+        with mock.patch("aiohttp.ClientSession", return_value=mock_client) as mock_build_client:
+            chunks = [chunk async for chunk in provider.chat_stream(payload)]
+
+        mock_build_client.assert_called_once()
+        mock_client.post.assert_called_once()
+        assert len(chunks) == len(call_counts)
+        calls = [call for chunk in chunks for call in chunk.choices[0].delta.tool_calls or []]
+        assert [call.index for call in calls] == list(range(sum(call_counts)))
+        assert all(json.loads(call.function.arguments) == {"location": "Singapore"} for call in calls)
+

+@pytest.mark.asyncio

+    ("indices", "expected"),
+    [

+async def test_chat_stream_tool_call_indices(indices, expected):
+    async def mock_stream():
+        for chunk_indices in indices:
+            tool_calls = []
+            for index in chunk_indices:
+                call = SimpleNamespace(
+                    id=None,
+                    type="function",
+                    function=SimpleNamespace(name=None, arguments='{"location":'),
+                )
+                if index != "missing":
+                    call.index = index
+                tool_calls.append(call)
+            yield SimpleNamespace(
+                id="chunk-1",
+                object="chat.completion.chunk",
+                created=1234567890,
+                model="claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022",
+                usage=None,
+                choices=[
+                    SimpleNamespace(
+                        index=0,
+                        finish_reason=None,
+                        delta=SimpleNamespace(tool_calls=tool_calls),
+                    )
+                ],

+
+    provider = LiteLLMProvider(EndpointConfig(**chat_config()))
+    payload = chat.RequestPayload(messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Weather?"}])

+
+    mock_completion.assert_called_once()
+    assert [
+        [call.index for call in chunk.choices[0].delta.tool_calls] for chunk in chunks
+    ] == expected
+    assert all(
+        call.function.arguments == '{"location":'
+        for chunk in chunks
+        for call in chunk.choices[0].delta.tool_calls
+    )
